ritualText:
SOFTEN BOTH SIDES OF SEEING

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

GOAL
Perceiver and perceived need not stay rigidly opposed.

1. Choose Simple — Choose a simple sound or imagined shape.
2. Attend Time — Notice both its qualities and the act of perceiving at the same time.
3. Place Reality — Refuse to place all reality on either side.
4. Let Relationship — Let seeing or hearing itself become primary for several seconds.

WIN
✓ Seeing became a relationship, not a rigid split.

• Keep identity fusion optional, especially when a sticky thought feels strong.
• Keep mental space visible when the thought stream gets loud.
• Do not let the thought stream decide what you deserve.
• Give freedom a chance before repeating thought fusion.
• Thoughts can stay present while you choose not to merge with them.

FORMULA FLOW
Choose Simple → Attend Time → Place Reality → Let Relationship

PAUSE
Keep ordinary boundaries clear in social, legal, and safety contexts.
This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
